tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Backward convergence at the poles to cigar solitons] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0127, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0128, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0129 ↗ prop:chow-iv-backward-pressure-cylinder ↗ lem:chow-iv-nonround-no-plane-limit ↗ lem:chow-iv-rescaled-pressure-growth 1. ch29:29.38\group Backward Geometry

For every nonround ancient solution and every sequence $t_i\to -\infty $, a subsequence of the solutions normalized at either pole converges smoothly on compact subsets to a cigar soliton. Equivalently, suitable conformal pullbacks converge in pointed smooth Cheeger--Gromov sense to a cigar.
